library.title: Library
library.count: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}}
library.emptyBody: Import a PDF to start. It is copied into Selis; the original file is never changed.
library.emptyFavoritesBody: Long-press a document to add it to your favorites.
library.emptyReceivedBody: Documents sent from your other devices appear here.
library.emptyTagBody: Long-press a document to tag it.
library.deleteImported: The copy in Selis, all its versions and its thumbnail will be deleted. The original file on your device stays as it is.
library.deleteLinked: The document will be removed from the library. The file itself is not touched.

recent.title: Recent
recent.emptyBody: Documents you open appear here, newest first.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.lockFooter: End-to-end encrypted. No account, no cloud.

send.chooseHelp: They go straight to your other device.
send.emptyBody: Import a PDF into your library, then send it from here.
send.includeHistoryHelp: Earlier versions go along with each document.
send.scanHelp: On the other device, open Selis › Transfer › Receive and scan this code.
send.confirmHelp: Does the other device show the same code? Confirm only if it does.
send.interrupted: Connection lost. Waiting for the other device to come back…
send.doneBody: {count, plural, one {# document arrived} other {# documents arrived}} on the other device.

receive.scanning: Point the camera at the code on the other device
receive.help: Both devices will show the same 6‑digit code. The sender confirms it.
receive.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. Paste the link instead, or allow the camera in system settings.
receive.cameraUnavailable: No camera available. Paste the link instead.
receive.confirmHelp: Check that the sending device shows this code. The transfer starts when they confirm.
receive.doneBody: {count, plural, one {# document was added to your library.} other {# documents were added to your library.}}
receive.duplicates: {count, plural, one {# was already there.} other {# were already there.}}
receive.pausedItem: {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} · {done} of {total}

error.expired: This code has expired. Ask the sender for a new one.
error.alreadyUsed: This code was already used. Ask the sender for a new one.
error.unknown: This code isn’t valid any more. Ask the sender for a new one.
error.declined: The code wasn’t confirmed, so nothing was sent.
error.unreachable: Couldn’t reach the other device. Make sure both are online (or on the same Wi‑Fi) and try again.
error.mismatch: The files didn’t arrive intact, so nothing was added.
error.protocol: The other device sent something unexpected. Update Selis on both devices.
error.storage: The files couldn’t be read or saved. Check the free space.
error.invalidLink: That isn’t a Selis transfer link.
error.notReady: The other device isn't ready. Open Selis › Transfer › Receive on it, and check that it saved this device.

debug.forceRelayHelp: Applies the next time this screen opens.

trust.sectionHelp: Send with one tap, no QR code. Open Receive on the other device first.
trust.removeBody: It will need a QR code and the confirmation code again, and can no longer send here without them.
trust.saveHelp: Next time, send to it with one tap. It can also send here while your Receive tab is open.
trust.receiveHint: Your saved devices can send here while this tab is open.

move.title: Move your library
move.body: Everything goes: documents with their versions, tags, favorites, signatures and settings. This device's key stays here.
move.versions: {count, plural, one {# earlier version} other {# earlier versions}}
move.repeatNote: Documents the other device already has are skipped.

settings.title: Settings
settings.localOnlyHelp: No relay. Transfers work only on the same Wi‑Fi.
settings.relayHelp: Your own iroh relay (https://…). Leave empty to use the public relays.
settings.footer: Selis {version} · Apache-2.0 · No account, no tracking

viewer.errorPassword: It is protected with a password. Password support is coming soon.
viewer.errorFormat: The file looks damaged or is not a valid PDF.
viewer.errorGeneric: Something went wrong while opening it.
viewer.selectDocument: Select a document to read it here
viewer.noOutline: This document has no table of contents.

desktop.placeholderTitle: Selis for desktop is on the way
desktop.placeholderBody: The desktop layout arrives in a later release. Make the window narrower to use the mobile layout today.

errors.notFound: The document is no longer available.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.importTimeout: Importing took too long, so nothing was added. Try again.
errors.pickerLost: The file picker didn’t return a file. Try again.
errors.conflict: A tag with this name already exists.

annotate.title: Annotate
annotate.hintMarkup: Drag across the text. Use two fingers to move around the page.
annotate.hintDraw: Draw with your finger or a stylus. Use two fingers to move around.
annotate.hintTap: Tap the page where you want it.
annotate.hintEraser: Tap or drag across an annotation to erase it.
annotate.failed: The change could not be applied. Try again.
annotate.saveFailed: Saving failed. Your changes stay in the document; try again.

recovery.title: Unsaved changes
recovery.body: Last time the app closed before your changes to this document were saved as a version. Do you want to recover them?
recovery.restored: Your changes were recovered and saved as a new version.

sign.title: Sign
sign.explain: An image of your signature on the page. It is not a certificate-based digital signature.
sign.emptyHint: You have no saved signature yet. Make one: draw it, type it or choose a picture.
sign.chooseHint: Choose a signature and tap the page.
sign.placeHint: Tap the page to place it. Drag to move it, drag the corner to resize.
sign.deleteBody: It is removed from your saved signatures. Copies already placed in documents stay.
sign.imageHint: Photograph your signature on white paper, in good light.
sign.imageFailed: The picture could not be opened. Try a PNG or JPEG.
sign.saveFailed: The signature was not saved. Try again.

forms.title: Form
forms.banner: {count, plural, one {Form with # field} other {Form with # fields}}
forms.flattenBody: Fields and annotations become part of the page and can no longer be filled in. The previous version stays in the history, and you can undo this until you close the document.
forms.noFields: This document has no form fields.
forms.failed: The field did not change. Try again.
forms.hint: Tap a field to fill it in.

pages.title: Pages
pages.hint: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} · Long-press and drag to reorder
pages.deleteBody: The pages are removed from the document. The previous version stays in the history, and you can undo this until you close the document.
pages.deleteAll: A document keeps at least one page.
pages.extractSelected: New document with the selected pages
pages.splitHint: Two new documents: the pages before it, and this page with the ones after it.
pages.extractNote: New documents go to the library; this document does not change.
pages.extracted: {count, plural, one {Created # new document in the library.} other {Created # new documents in the library.}}
pages.failed: The pages did not change. Try again.
pages.lossTitle: Some parts of this PDF will not come along
pages.lossBody: The pages and their text, images and form fields are inserted. These are left out:
pages.lossSignatures: {count, plural, one {# signature field} other {# signature fields}}
pages.lossTooltips: {count, plural, one {# field tooltip} other {# field tooltips}}

redact.title: Redact
redact.hintText: Drag across the text to remove.
redact.hintArea: Drag a box: everything under it is removed (text, images, comments, fields).
redact.hintWhiteout: Drag a box and type the text that replaces it (or leave it empty).
redact.hintEraser: Tap a mark to take it away.
redact.confirmTitle: {count, plural, one {Remove content under # mark for good?} other {Remove content under # marks for good?}}
redact.confirmBody: Whatever is under the marks (text, images, drawings, comments, field values) is removed from the file, not just covered. It does not come back in the new version. You can undo this until you close the document. Earlier versions in the history still have it: when you are done, Selis offers to delete them.
redact.discarded: {count, plural, one {The mark that was not applied was removed.} other {The # marks that were not applied were removed.}}
redact.failed: Redaction failed. The document did not change.
redact.earlierBody: The new version no longer contains what you removed. The earlier versions of this document in Selis, the imported original among them, still do.
redact.earlierDeleted: {count, plural, =0 {No earlier versions to delete.} one {Deleted # earlier version.} other {Deleted # earlier versions.}}
redact.earlierFailed: The earlier versions could not be deleted.
redact.sideLinked: This is a linked file: the original outside Selis still contains this text. Only the new version in Selis changes.
redact.sideNotes: {count, plural, one {# note elsewhere also goes, because it shares a removed word: {list}} other {# notes elsewhere also go, because they share a removed word: {list}}}
redact.sideOwnerPassword: The document's owner password and its permission settings are not kept in the new version.
redact.earlierConfirmBody: Every earlier version of this document in Selis is deleted, the imported copy among them. Only the new version stays. A linked original outside Selis is not touched. This cannot be undone.
